'''Molemen''' were [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Color/Legends|white]]-skinned blind [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] that wore [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]].<ref name="CL" /> During a [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="22 BBY">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'' depicts three molemen visiting the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] at the same [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|visited]] the establishment during the events of {{Film|II}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> three members of the [[Species/Legends|species]] visited the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="CL" /> [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] interrogated the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] outside the club, a tour guide led the molemen to the Outlander's Digisee Gaming Floor.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The molemen were first mentioned in the [[2003]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', authored by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="Inside">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The species was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
